sdk.//: latestFeature, not minor: 'minor' prefers the highest patch of the requested feature band (11.0.2xx) over rolling forward, so on a machine that has 11.0.2xx and 11.0.4xx side by side it picks the 2xx - whose Roslyn is older than the one CodeGenerators is built against, and it fails to load with CS9057. latestFeature takes the newest 11.0.x installed instead.
sdk.//prerelease: The exact rc build, not 11.0.100: a prerelease sorts below the release it precedes, so asking for 11.0.100 does not resolve 11.0.100-rc.1. Drop allowPrerelease and pin 11.0.100 at RTM.
